name: Eva Zielińska

events.place: House #156, Olesko, Bezirk Złoczów, Kingdom of Galicia and Lodomeria, Austria-Hungary

notes: Family History Centre: Refer to copy of LDS film # 2037644, page 89 which records the marriage of Eva Zielinska and Gregorius Korytko on Nov. 10, 1889.  This document shows parents on both sides and provides age at marriage.  In the case of Eva, she was 26 which then makes her birth year approximately 1863 which has been used in this BK record.
